DitherImageCompare.palette: Two or more colours. Pixels take the nearest one.
DitherImageCompare.labels: Show the corner labels. They fade out when the divider comes near.
DitherImageCompare.hint: Nudge the divider once when it first appears.
DitherImageCompare.value: Divider position from the left, 0 to 100.
DitherImageCompare.changed: The new position, while dragging or on key presses.
